**Indikator 11** is a clinical quality indicator introduced in the Danish national registry for ADHD treatment. It measures the proportion of treatment courses among adults (18 years and older) with an ADHD diagnosis where the patient receives pharmacological treatment within 120 days of starting a package course [^src2]. Medical treatment is the most frequent treatment modality offered in hospital-based psychiatry, making this indicator a central metric for evaluating systemic adherence to clinical guidelines [^src2]. 

### Chronology and Context
In 2024, the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] was expanded to include adults in the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]], having previously only covered children and youth [^src2]. This systemic expansion led to the first-ever calculation of Indikator 11 [^src2]. The initial measurement period spans from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025 [^src2]. Because it is the first time the indicator is being reported, it is presented entirely without historical data or trend graphs [^src1]. Furthermore, there is currently no established development target (udviklingsmål) for this indicator [^src2]. The [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Group) is scheduled to make a final decision at their next meeting regarding whether Indikator 11 should officially remain a core metric or be reclassified as supplementary material [^src2].

### National and Regional Performance
Nationally, 70% (95% CI: 68–72) of adults were in treatment with ADHD medication during the reporting period [^src1]. The data completeness for this metric is considered highly reliable, as it relies on the medicinal product statistics database where all redeemed prescriptions are automatically registered [^src2]. 

However, the initial results reveal significant regional disparities. [[region-nordjylland|Nordjylland]] achieved the highest result at 85% [^src2], followed by [[region-sjaelland|Sjælland]] at 81% [^src2], [[region-midtjylland|Midtjylland]] at 80% [^src2], and [[region-syddanmark|Syddanmark]] at 67% [^src2]. In stark contrast, [[region-hovedstaden|Hovedstaden]] performed significantly lower than the rest of the country with a result of just 37% [^src2]. Analysts note that these large regional differences are likely driven primarily by registration and administrative difficulties in Region Hovedstaden rather than actual discrepancies in clinical practice [^src2]. Additionally, the almost non-existent number of treatment courses reported from [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] makes it impossible to assess whether private providers are meeting the quality indicators [^src2].

### Pharmacological Scope
The indicator strictly tracks specific ATC-coded medications to determine compliance. The included pharmaceuticals are [[dexamfetamin-n06ba02|Dexamfetamin (N06BA02)]], [[methylphenidat-n06ba04|Methylphenidat (N06BA04)]], [[modafinil-n06ba07|Modafinil (N06BA07)]], [[atomoxetin-n06ba09|Atomoxetin (N06BA09)]], [[lisdexamfetamin-n06ba12|Lisdexamfetamin (N06BA12)]], and [[guanfacin-c02ac02|Guanfacin (C02AC02)]] [^src2]. At the departmental level, performance varied widely, with units like [[ps-almenpsykiatrisk-syd-ambulatorier|PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier]] reaching 100%, while others such as [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik]] recorded only 21% [^src2].

## Timeline
- 2024: ADHD-databasen blev udvidet til også at omfatte voksne i behandlingspopulationen, hvilket førte til første beregning af Indikator 11. (adhd-databasen, indikator-11) [^src2]
- 1. april 2024: Start af opgørelsesperioden for Indikator 11 (1. april 2024 – 31. marts 2025). (indikator-11) [^src2]
